Grow Channels (NFT channels).name: Polyethylene

Reservoir Tank.name: Polyethylene
Reservoir Tank.reasoning: Widely used polymer for reservoir tanks due to its chemical resistance, durability, and food-safe properties; industry standard for hydroponic reservoirs.

Reservoir Tank.name: Polypropylene
Reservoir Tank.reasoning: Common alternative polymer for reservoir tanks, also chemically resistant and durable; moderately used and can substitute polyethylene.
